title: After the update, a long-time member's first empty workout still starts blank
what: 'Empty workout remembers last time's exercises' only starts remembering from the first empty workout finished after the update. A member who has logged empty workouts for months opens Start empty workout after updating and gets nothing pre-added, although their last empty workout is right there in their history. Only from the next one on does it work.
expected: On the first start after the update, the last finished empty workout already in the history fills the list once, so existing members get the feature at once.
how_often: once per member, the first empty workout after the update
fix_line: Fill the remembered list once from the last finished empty workout in the history

items.reason: Update-time data repairs in this area: the imported-times repair can run twice (existing finding), the Hevy-link folder repair runs once and touches only untouched copies, a followed plan from before the week rule gets its start day from history once, photos come back from the backup folder after a reinstall (existing finding on a silent failure). Watch, sideload/Play package and panel cache are not in these files (watch files sort after plansService).

Member leaves: gym plan folders kept as 'No longer sent', diet plans removed, measurements kept; member returns to the same gym: a 'gone' folder is saved again (not gone). Gym plan end (Pro lock): old diet plans stay as current (existing finding). App not opened for months: plan week keeps counting (existing finding), forgotten workout keeps a running clock (existing finding). Dates are local calendar days (addDays/daysBetween), import rejects 31 Feb; no year-end or leap-day fault found in these files. Trial end, staff leaving and owner phone change do not apply to these member-side files.

New rules with an explicit path for existing users: plan start day taken from history, old focus block runs to its end, old Hevy-link folders repaired once, old imported times repaired once. Empty-workout memory has no path for existing members (finding).

Marks in these files: the first-routine guide shows only with no routines and is marked done once routines are seen; record alerts skip the first time ('the first time is not news'); the finish screen's badge line lists only badges this workout earned. No What's new or dot marks here.
No mark found that calls something new that is not new to the member.
